details.biography:
The Broken Anvil · Level 9 - The Veterans · Seat 3, Healer

A dark-skinned aasimar priestess of Lathander who blazes with dawn light when she prays, and brings her warhammer down like a sunrise breaking. Patient, sunny and quietly stubborn, she believes every bad night ends in a morning. She joined the Keepers because Burrow's Den needed a healer who would walk into the dark with them, not wait at the gate.

In a fight

Open with Bless or Prayer, then keep everyone standing: Spirit Guardians when foes close in, Healing Circle when the whole line is hurt. Save Flame Strike for the troll, whose fire keeps it down.
details.backgroundStory:
Abilities (from the printed sheet)

Spell Use. Wisdom caster, spell DC 17. Each morning prepare 12 spells from the Cleric list (level 9 + Wisdom 3); your 5 cantrips are extra. Slots: 1st 5, 2nd 5, 3rd 4, 4th 2, 5th 1 (Wisdom bonus slots included).

Turn Undead. As an action, 6 times a day, present your holy symbol: every undead within 30ft that can see or hear you makes a Will save (DC 17). On a failure it is destroyed if its Level is 4 or lower, otherwise turned.

Perfect Recall. Once a day, with a DC 10 Wisdom check, recast a 1st-level spell you have already cast, without a slot.

Banish. Turn Undead also works on fiends and other extraplanar creatures, as a Cleric 4 levels lower. One that fails is driven back to its own plane if its Level is 4 or lower, otherwise turned.

Divine Monolith. A permanent 10ft aura that can't be dispelled: you and allies in it have Advantage on Will saves, and undead have Disadvantage on saves against your Turn Undead.

Kit: Granted Power (Lathander). Advantage on your first attack roll each round against undead. Once a day, a 20ft burst of dawn light: undead in it make a Will save or flee for 1 minute.

Weapon Selection. The whole Cleric weapon list (your war hammer is on it), plus Lathander's favoured heavy mace.

Aasimar. Darkvision 60ft. Resistance 5 to necrotic and radiant. Advantage on saves against being Frightened. Once a day, shed bright light in a 10ft radius; once a day, Lay on Hands to heal 9 HP. Knack: Advantage on Singing checks.

Healer (1st, Arcane & Devout). Healing spells restore +1 HP per die (included in the spell lines). Once a day, cast a healing spell of 3rd level or lower without using a slot.

War Caster (4th, Arcane & Devout). Advantage on Fortitude saves to keep a spell when you take damage, and you cast with hammer and shield in hand.

Toughness (8th, General). +1 HP per level and +1 Constitution (both included); Advantage on Constitution checks.

HP. 1st level: d8 max 8 + Con 2 = 10. Levels 2 to 9: 8 x (5 + 2) = 56. Toughness: 9. Total 75.

Casting

Sacred Flame (cantrip): 60ft, one creature you can see: 2d4 radiant, Reflex DC 17 negates; cover gives no bonus to the save.

Toll the Dead (cantrip): 60ft, one creature: 2d4 necrotic, or 2d6 if it is below its maximum HP; Will DC 17 negates.

First Aid (cantrip): touch: a dying creature is stabilised at its current HP, no roll. It stays Unconscious and regains no HP.

Light (cantrip): touch an object: bright light 20ft and dim light 20ft more, for 9 hours.

Detect Magic (cantrip, ritual): self, 60ft cone, 9 rounds: see which creatures and objects carry magic, and the school of the strongest aura.

Cure Light Wounds (1st): touch: heals 1d8+6 (1d8+5, +1 from Healer).

Bless (1st): 50ft, up to 6 allies, 1 minute: Advantage on the first attack roll each round and +1 to saves. Reversed (Bane) on 6 enemies, Will DC 17 negates.

Command (1st): 30ft, one creature that understands you: Approach, Drop, Flee or Halt on its next turn. Will DC 17 negates; mindless creatures are immune.

Guiding Bolt (1st): 120ft, one creature: 3d8 radiant, Reflex DC 17 halves. The next attack roll on it before the end of your next turn has Advantage (a save negates that).

Aid (2nd): touch, 9 minutes: Advantage on the first attack roll each round, +1 to saves and 1d8 temporary HP. Not with Bless.

Hold Person (2nd): 120ft, one humanoid (hobgoblins count): Paralysed for 9 rounds, repeating the save each turn. Will DC 17 negates.

Spiritual Weapon (2nd): 60ft, 9 rounds: on each of your turns it hits one creature within 5ft of it for 1d6+3 force, no roll. Move it 30ft a round; AC 15, 10 HP.

Cure Serious Wounds (3rd): touch: heals 2d8+11 (2d8+9, +2 from Healer).

Prayer (3rd): 40ft radius on you, 9 rounds: allies have Advantage on their first attack roll each round and +1 to damage and saves; enemies have Disadvantage and -1. No save.

Spirit Guardians (3rd): self, 15ft radius that moves with you, 9 rounds: enemies entering or starting their turn in it move at half speed and take 1d6 radiant or necrotic (chosen on casting), once a round. Will DC 17 halves.

Healing Circle (4th): 30ft, 20ft-radius burst: every living creature in it heals 1d8+10 (1d8+9, +1 from Healer). Mind the foes in the burst.

Flame Strike (5th): 60ft, 10ft-radius, 40ft-high cylinder: 9d6, half fire and half radiant, Reflex DC 17 halves. Fire, for the troll.

Armour Class on the sheet: 10 + 8 (Plate Mail +1) + 0 (heavy armour: no Dex) + 1 (Shield, Medium Steel) = 19

Class Abilities

1st Level

Spell Use

  • Effect: Cast divine spells per the Spells Per Day table. Bonus slots from high Wisdom (see Spellcasting in Arneyan, II).

Turn Undead

  • Effect: As an action, up to 3 + your Wisdom modifier times per day, present your holy symbol — every undead within 30ft that can see or hear you rolls a Will save.
  • Turn DC = your Class Save DC
  • Below 8th level: failed save = turned — undead flees and cannot approach within 30ft for 1 minute
  • 8th level and above: failed save = destroyed outright if its Level is no more than half your Cleric level, otherwise turned
  • Evil Clerics may turn OR control undead under the same DC — controlling requires your Cleric level to be 5 or more above the undead's Level. Controlled undead obey for 1 hour per Cleric level, and you can control at most your Cleric level in total Levels of undead at once

Weapon Selection

  • Effect: Full Cleric weapon list usable without disadvantage. Faith additionally grants automatic training in the deity's specific favoured weapon, even if it falls outside the standard list.

Battle Priest

  • Effect: If your deity is a war god (Torm, Helm, Tyr, Drake, Moradin, Gruumsh, Maglubiyet, Bane, Zindel of Mournas or Daeric Khyrmin), you can become a Battle Priest when you take your first Cleric level.
  • The choice is permanent.
  • You use the Knight Base to Hit track (the Paladin's: +7 at 12th, +15 at 24th) instead of the Cleric's, you gain Extra Attack at 7th level, and your spell slots come from the Spells Per Day row two below your Cleric level (none at 1st or 2nd level).
  • Cantrips, Turn Undead and your deity's granted power are unchanged.
  • A Battle Priest needs 12 XP per level, like the Paladin, instead of the Cleric's 10.

3rd Level

  • Perfect Recall: recall a previously cast 1st-level spell once per day via a Wisdom check (DC 10, the Easy tier), casting it again without expending a slot; from 13th level it also works for previously cast 2nd-level spells

5th Level

Banish

  • Effect: Your Turn Undead also works on fiends and other extraplanar creatures, as if you were a Cleric 4 levels lower. A fiend or other extraplanar creature that fails is driven back to its own plane if its Level is no more than half your Cleric level; otherwise it is turned.

7th Level

  • Extra Attack (Battle Priest only): When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).

9th Level

Divine Monolith

  • Effect: A permanent 10ft aura of divine power that cannot be dispelled. You and your allies within it have Advantage on Will saves, and undead have Disadvantage on their saves against your Turn Undead.

15th Level

  • Wisdom Bonus: permanent +1 Wisdom

18th Level

Holy Campaign

  • Effect: Once per year, or once per campaign at the GM's call, raise 1–100 NPCs with d8 HD plus 1–100 NPCs with d4 HD. All gain +1 on checks while the Cleric is present.
  • Scales at 19th: 2–200 / 2–200 NPCs, bonus increases to +2
  • Scales at 23rd: 4–400 / 4–400 NPCs, bonus increases to +3, gains 1st/2nd/3rd level leaders per 20 troops

21st Level

Banish (Improved)

  • Effect: Banish now works at your full level and reaches the greatest outsiders:
  • Banishes for 21+ days
  • Affects 1d12 minor demons or devils
  • Affects 1d6 major demons or devils
  • Affects 1 demon lord or arch devil

22nd Level

Divine Monolith (Improved)

  • Effect: The aura grows to 20ft and its power deepens:
  • All creatures within the aura are immune to death attacks
  • All creatures within the aura, you included, have Advantage on all saves and attribute checks (instead of on Will saves only)

23rd Level

Mark of the Saint

  • Effect: Recognised as a saint regardless of alignment.
  • Gains 1d10 followers per Wisdom point
  • Grants weekly: Heal, Remove Blindness or Deafness, Remove Disease
  • Grants daily: Holy or Unholy Word
  • Grants weekly: Resurrection

Deities and Kits

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Cleric folder. Drag one onto your character.

  • The Cleric's kit is their deity.
  • Choose one at character creation.
  • Your deity grants a favoured weapon (automatic training even outside the standard list) and a unique granted power, and you follow its tenets (see Divine Favour in Book II).
  • Most deities grant one daily power; a few improve a class feature instead.
  • The archdevils and demon lords not listed here (every one but Asmodeus and Lolth) serve only as Warlock patrons.
